visionMission.title: Our Vision
visionMission.text: “We Don’t Wait for Change. We Build It — Together.” We envision an inclusive, healthy, educated and empowered India where every child, woman, youth and citizen has access to education, healthcare, opportunity, safety and dignity.We strive for a drug-free, digitally aware, socially just and environmentally responsible India — where no one is left behind.Together, we turn compassion into action and communities into stronger futures.

visionMission.title: Our Mission
visionMission.text: “Serve with Purpose. Empower with Action. Transform Lives.” Our mission is to turn social challenges into practical solutions and lasting impact through education, healthcare, sports, youth and women empowerment, social justice, child development, anti-drug and cyber awareness, environmental sustainability and community welfare.We believe in creating solutions, building opportunities and empowering people — working together to build a healthier, safer, greener, more inclusive and developed India.

treeBranches.label: SPORTS
treeBranches.short: Grassroots athletics, athletic kit distributions, football & cricket coaching, and girls self-defense boot camps.

treeBranches.label: HEALTH
treeBranches.short: Free mobile medical camps, diabetes/hypertension screenings, eye care with glasses, and maternal-child nutrition aid.

treeBranches.label: SOCIAL-JUSTICE & WELFARE
treeBranches.short: Free community legal aid clinics, constitutional rights advocacy, senior citizen welfare, and equality initiatives.

treeBranches.label: ANTI-CYBER CRIME
treeBranches.short: School and college workshops on online fraud prevention, digital banking safety, cyberbullying defense, and helpline awareness.

treeBranches.label: ANTI-DRUGS
treeBranches.short: Grassroots anti-narcotics drives, street-theatre awareness, youth counseling circles, and rehabilitation center partnerships.

treeBranches.label: YOUTH EMPOWERMENT
treeBranches.short: Laptop distribution drives for girls, digital literacy classrooms, career guidance, and leadership mentorship programs.

treeAnatomy.title: COMPASSION
treeAnatomy.text: Deeply anchored in genuine empathy for the vulnerable, homeless, and marginalized. We believe kindness without judgment is the only foundation capable of sustaining lasting social justice.

treeAnatomy.title: SERVICE (SEVA)
treeAnatomy.text: Unyielding, disciplined, and transparent daily action. From on-ground laptop handovers to night food patrols, our service channels our empathy into tangible community infrastructure.

treeAnatomy.title: CORE FOCUS PILLARS
treeAnatomy.text: Spreading shade and empowerment across Sports, Health, Social-Justice & Welfare, Anti-Cyber Crime, Anti-Drugs, and Youth Empowerment.

items.name: Raksha Deshmukh
items.title: 50 Laptops Gifted: Truly inspiring and empowering!
items.comment: Great initiative by Shabbir Shaikh and Janseva Pratishthan Foundation! Giving 50 brand-new laptops to deserving female students has changed my daughter’s future. She can now pursue her STEM coding classes with pride. May this noble mission reach thousands more!

items.name: Varun Patil
items.title: Small Steps, Big Impact in True Reality
items.comment: I have volunteered with many NGOs, but the genuine grassroots sincerity here is unmatched. During the laptop distribution and health camps, every child and elder was treated with royal dignity. Transparent, fearless, and deeply empathetic leadership.

items.name: Nandini Sharma
items.title: Amazing initiative by Shabbir Sir and the Foundation
items.comment: Amazing initiative by Janseva Pratishthan! 50 laptop gifts to deserving students is truly inspiring and a deeply thoughtful milestone. Kudos to the entire team for believing in our potential when resources were scarce.

items.name: Sanskriti Chouhan
items.title: Inspiring event that brings hope to marginalized homes
items.comment: 50 laptops for underprivileged students was not just an event; it was a festival of hope. What touched me most was how the foundation couples digital literacy with sports gear and moral values. Keep shining!

items.name: Mohammad Farhan
items.title: Sports kits and anti-drug mentorship gave us purpose
items.comment: The sports equipment and athletics coaching provided by Janseva Pratishthan Foundation kept our neighborhood youth united and away from bad habits. The Nasha Mukti pledge drives gave us self-respect and athletic ambition.

items.name: Dr. A. K. Kulkarni
items.title: Exemplary Healthcare Camps & Dignity
items.comment: Collaborated with the foundation during mobile health and hygiene camps. From maternal diagnostic checkups to sanitary kit distribution under Project Swabhiman, the operational discipline is world-class.
